Dave (Finance): CloudHarbor reached out — April invoice shows a 38% jump vs their internal counts. They say they only had a small traffic increase. Can billing/platform triage? /cc @Priya @Mateo
Priya (Billing Ops): Pulling ledger vs ingest now. Which tenant id? cloudharbor-prod.
Billing Bot: invoice=2026-04 customer_id=cloudharbor-prod billed_embed_units=2,340,800 billable_amount=$842.88
Mateo (Platform): Noted. We rolled "ingest-sampler" for noisy streams on 2026-04-05 to reduce storage/cost. Sampler should mark events as sampled and not change billing, but I'm seeing sample_factor propagated into metering incorrectly. Investigating.
Hana (Eng-Infra): Running quick query to compare raw ingest events vs metering records for CloudHarbor April window.
Hana (Eng-Infra): ```
SELECT event_day, SUM(raw_embed_units) as ingest_units, SUM(metered_units) as billed_units
FROM metering.day_agg
WHERE customer_id='cloudharbor-prod' AND event_day >= '2026-04-01' AND event_day <= '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY event_day
ORDER BY event_day;
```
Hana (Eng-Infra): Aggregate result shows ingest_units=1,680,200 vs billed_units=2,340,800. Billed > ingest by 660,600 units.
Priya (Billing Ops): That's odd — billed > ingest. Were sampled placeholders billed at full unit weight?
Mateo (Platform): Sampler was supposed to emit a "sampled=true" tag and a sample_factor so billing would multiply sampled_unit * sample_factor. Due to a bug (sampler v0.9.2), sample_factor was set to 0 for many events but metering interpreted missing/zero as 1, and in a later backfill we multiplied by the original request_count again. Long story short: some events were double-counted during the rehydrate/backfill flow.
Luis (Customer Success): CloudHarbor is already unhappy. They provided some example request_ids — want to show before/after and explain.
Hana (Eng-Infra): Running targeted diagnostic for one example id: request_id=ch-7f9a
Hana (Eng-Infra): ```
SELECT trace_id, event_time, sample_tag, sample_factor, raw_units, metered_units
FROM ingestion.events
LEFT JOIN metering.events USING(trace_id)
WHERE trace_id='ch-7f9a' LIMIT 5;
```
Hana (Eng-Infra): Example: first ingest (sampled=true sample_factor=100 raw_units=12) then rehydrate job emitted the original payload and metering recorded metered_units=12 and backfill applied sample_factor=100 again, resulting in billed_units=1200 for that trace.
Mateo (Platform): Ugh. So backfill rehydrate applied sampling multiplier twice for some traces. I can run a rollup to estimate delta.
Mateo (Platform): Quick rollup: estimated double-count delta = 660,600 embed units for April.
Priya (Billing Ops): CloudHarbor rate is $0.00038/unit (negotiated). Delta ~$251.03.
Dave (Finance): Policy check: for inadvertent overbilling caused by our pipeline bug, do we credit? My read: yes, unless customer used sampled data intentionally and accepted results. But honestly this is our bug.
Luis (Customer Success): CloudHarbor expects a full credit and an explanation of what we changed. They also ask for confirmation this won't happen again.
Hana (Eng-Infra): I created INFRA-9021: "sampler: ensure rehydrate/backfill applies sample_factor idempotently". Patch in review, and I'm adding a post-backfill audit job to detect sample_factor > 1 applied multiple times.
Priya (Billing Ops): Recommendation: issue full credit for the delta ($252 rounded) and attach CSV showing traces and delta calc. Approve?
Dave (Finance): Approve full credit of $252 as goodwill and because this was our processing bug. Please add a short customer note and mark invoice note with INFRA-9021 reference.
Billing Bot: credit_queued customer=cloudharbor-prod invoice=2026-04 amount=$252 ref=CH-CR-2012345678 status=queued
Mateo (Platform): Also adding a monitoring alert: per-customer billed/ingest ratio > 1.15 sustained for 30m triggers immediate investigation. Will file PLAT-9033.
Luis (Customer Success): I'll send the customer message tonight: apology, root cause summary (sampler/backfill double-apply), credit applied, and mitigations (INFRA-9021 + PLAT-9033).
Priya (Billing Ops): I'll attach the CSV and mark invoice as adjusted. Also will run a sweep to find other tenants affected by the samplers during 2026-04-05..2026-04-09 window and post results in #finance.
Billing Bot: sweep_started window=2026-04-05..2026-04-09 check=sample_factor_idempotence status=running
Dave (Finance): Thanks team. Keep me posted if sweep finds other accounts > $1k so we can review approvals.
